reel_check.source: yes: Ubisoft Steam announcement 'Dawn of the Delta is now available' 5 Nov (store.steampowered.com/news/app/3274580/view/687520963569388747) via HowToVideoGame, and Anno Union release-day post (anno-union.com/union-update-its-release-day-for-dawn-of-the-delta/) read in full; Publer 7 days and board must_not_repeat clean
reel_check.angle: hook: Roman Egypt arrives in Anno 117; why now: out 5 Nov, free base-game weekend to 9 Nov; players here: Egypt setting, free to try base game; payoff: free weekend without DLC
reel_check.type: OUT NOW: platforms not stated by Anno Union so not claimed on screen
reel_check.footage: Steam Gameplay Trailer of the base game, subtitles cropped out, credited as base-game footage; the DLC launch trailer is YouTube only
reel_check.sound: our bed (launch): Steam Gameplay Trailer narration runs through the whole trailer and the music stem was not clean (7.7% leftover, run 24); Accolades and Year 1 trailers are text cards
reel_check.names: Anno 117 and Dawn of the Delta Latin; Ubisoft bracketed in credit; إضافة per glossary
